title: Rito, You Became a Girl!
overview: When Lala heard that all men are interested in boobs she started to make an invention that will make her boobs bigger. All of a sudden Rito flies out from a school window and crashes into the invention turning him into a girl.

title: Rito and Mikan
overview: Rito is always spending time with Lala, he barely talks to Mikan that much so she felt a little lonely and stormed out of the house alone, While Rito and Lala went looking for her, there are few flashbacks of Rito and Mikan in the past as Rito and Lala try to find Mikan.

title: Welcome to the Resort
overview: Haruna wins a south island resort trip for ten females.
